description: Solana token safety check. Pass a mint (for example DezXAZ8z7PnrnRJjz3wXBoRgixCa6xjnB7YaB1pPB263) and get mint authority, freeze authority, indexed liquidity, largest-account concentration, market age, and a simple risk score. Token data is read from Solana mainnet. Price is 0.01 USDC per call. ($0.01 USDC per call via x402 at https://coinlight-app.vercel.app/p/solana-token-safety)

payment.description: Optional x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value. Omit to use a free trial call or get payment requirements.
